spotlight.title: Annual Mawlid un Nabi
spotlight.description: At the heart of Mawlid is gratitude to Allah Almighty for sending the Best of Creation, our beloved Master Sayyiduna Muhammad—peace and blessings be upon him, his family and companions. Open either poster for the full programme.
